entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
An asker (i.e. Nadr Bin Haarith) is (mockingly) asking for that punishment.
Which is going to take place upon the disbelievers; no one can avert it.
That (punishment) will be from Allah, the Owner of the heights.

The angels and Jibra'eel ascend towards His Majestic Court, that punishment will befall the disbelievers on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years (according to the worldly calculation of time).
Therefore (O Beloved), be admirably patient.
They assume it (i.e. the punishment) to be far away.
Whereas, We are seeing (that its inevitable happening) is near.
The Day when the sky will be like molten silver.
And the mountains will become light like wool.
And no friend will ask concerning any (of his friends).

They will be seeing them (i.e. their friends and family); the criminal will wish if only he could pay ransom, from the punishment of that Day, by offering his sons (as a payment to get out of the trouble).
And his wife and his brother.
And his (caring) family member who provided him shelter (from the hardships in this world).
And all those who are on the earth; then this ransom might save him (from the punishment of Allah).
Never (i.e. nothing will save him)! That is actually a Blazing Fire.
The one which strips off the skin is calling.
Him who turned his back away and turned his face (from the truth).
And accumulated (wealth) and saved it (without spending in the path of Allah).
Indeed, mankind has been made very impatient, greedy.
Very anxious when misfortune reaches him.
And stingy when good reaches him.
Except those who offer Salah.
Those who are punctual with their Salah.
And those in whose wealth there is a known right (i.e. Zakah, Fitrah, etc.).
For the one who begs; and for the one who cannot even beg, so (he) remains deprived.
And those who believe the Day of Judgement to be true.
And those who are fearing the punishment of their Lord.
Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not a thing to be unafraid of.
And those who protect their private parts.
Except from their wives or the slave-girls in their possession, that there is no criticism on them.
So, he who desires more than these two, it is they who are the transgressors.
And those who are mindful of their trusts and their covenant.
And those who are firm upon their testimonies.
And those who protect their Salah.
It is they who will be honoured in Gardens (of Paradise).
So, what is the matter with those disbelievers, they gaze at you (O Beloved) with an eager look (to find faults in you and your religion)?
From the right and the left, in numerous groups.
Does every person amongst them desire to be admitted into the Garden of tranquillity?
Never! We have indeed created them from a thing they know (i.e. from sperm).
So, I swear an oath by the Owner of every East and every West that We are indeed Powerful.
To replace (the disbelievers) with those who are better than them, and no one can escape from Us.
So (O Beloved), leave them to indulge in their rudeness and to play, until they confront that Day of theirs of which they are promised.
The Day when they will come out of the graves in haste, as if rushing towards their (fixed) signposts.
With lowered eyes, disgrace overcame them; such is that Day of theirs which they had been promised.
